added: Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is a leading international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies.
We operate two business segments that offer beauty products in key categories, including hair care, hair color, styling tools, and nails.

The Sally Beauty (“Sally”) segment operates as an omni-channel retailer that offers professional-quality beauty supplies at attractive prices and provides education to retail consumers and salon professionals throughout North America, including Puerto Rico, South America, and Europe.

Sally operates primarily through domestic and international retail stores (generally operating under the Sally Beauty banner) and digital platforms, including our www.sallybeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and third-party digital marketplaces.

The Beauty Systems Group (“BSG”) segment operates as a full-service omni-channel distributor that offers professional beauty supplies exclusively to salons and licensed beauty professionals throughout the U.S., including Puerto Rico, and Canada.

BSG operates through company-operated stores (generally operating under the Cosmo Prof banner), franchised stores through its Armstrong McCall business, salon business consultants (“SBCs”), and digital platforms, including our www.cosmoprofbeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and chain portals.

text: Basis of Presentation and Significant Accounting Policies Description of Business

Sally Beauty Holdings, Inc. is a leading international specialty retailer and distributor of professional beauty supplies. We operate two business segments that offer beauty products in key categories, including hair care, hair color, styling tools, and nails.

The Sally Beauty (“Sally”) segment operates as an omni-channel retailer that offers professional-quality beauty supplies at attractive prices and provides education to retail consumers and salon professionals throughout North America, including Puerto Rico, South America, and Europe. Sally operates primarily through domestic and international retail stores (generally operating under the Sally Beauty banner) and digital platforms, including our www.sallybeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and third-party digital marketplaces.

The Beauty Systems Group (“BSG”) segment operates as a full-service omni-channel distributor that offers professional beauty supplies exclusively to salons and licensed beauty professionals throughout the U.S., including Puerto Rico, and Canada. BSG operates through company-operated stores (generally operating under the Cosmo Prof banner), franchised stores through its Armstrong McCall business, salon business consultants (“SBCs”), and digital platforms, including our www.cosmoprofbeauty.com website, a mobile commerce-based app, and chain portals.
Basis of Presentation

The consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (“GAAP”). All significant intercompany accounts and transactions have been eliminated in consolidation.
Reclassifications
Certain prior period amounts have been reclassified or combined to conform to the current period presentation.
Fiscal Year

The Company operates on a fiscal year, which ends on September 30. Fiscal 2026 ended September 30, 2026; fiscal 2025 ended September 30, 2025, and fiscal 2024 ended September 30, 2024. Unless otherwise stated, references to years in this report relate to fiscal years, rather than to calendar years.
Use of Estimates

In order to present our financial statements in conformity with GAAP, we are required to make certain estimates and assumptions that impact our financial statements and supplementary disclosures. These estimates may use forecasted financial information based on reasonable information available; however, they are subject to change in the future. Our significant estimates and assumptions include sales allowances, deferred revenue, vendor rebates and concessions, inventory valuation, amortization and depreciation, goodwill, other intangible assets, and other reserves. We believe our estimates and assumptions are reasonable; however, changes in facts and circumstances may result in actual results that differ materially from our estimates.

text: Debt Short-term Debt

Our ABL Facility provides us with a revolving commitment of $500.0 million that matures on December 11, 2029. The interest rate on the ABL Facility is variable and determined at our option as (i) prime plus 0.25% or 0.50% or (ii) Secured Overnight Financing Rate (“SOFR”) plus 1.25% or 1.50%. In addition, the terms of the ABL Facility contain a commitment fee of 0.25% on the unused portion of the facility. Borrowings under the ABL Facility are secured by a first-priority lien in and upon the accounts and inventory (and the proceeds thereof) of the Company and its guarantor subsidiaries. Furthermore, the ABL Facility is also secured by a second-priority lien in and upon the remaining assets of the Company and its guarantor subsidiaries.

At September 30, 2026 and 2025, there were no outstanding borrowings under our ABL Facility. At September 30, 2026, we had $482.4 million available for borrowing thereunder, including our Canadian sub-facility, subject to borrowing base limitations, as reduced by outstanding letters of credit.

We are party to a credit agreement for a term loan B due 2030 (“TLB”) that bears interest at a floating rate equal to, at our option, either the Adjusted Term SOFR Rate plus 1.75% or an adjusted base rate plus 0.75%; see below for additional information. Interest on the TLB is payable quarterly on the last day of each March, June, September, and December of each year. The TLB matures on February 28, 2030 (the “Maturity Date”), but may be prepaid without penalty or premium, other than customary breakage costs for prepayments that are made prior to the last date of an interest period. The principal of the TLB is repayable in $1.0 million quarterly installments, with the remaining outstanding principal amount due on the Maturity Date.

The TLB is secured by a first-priority lien in and upon substantially all of the assets of the Company and its domestic subsidiaries other than the accounts, inventory (and the proceeds thereof) and other assets that secure Sally Holdings’ existing ABL Facility on a first-priority basis (the “ABL Priority Collateral”). Additionally, the TLB is secured by a second-priority lien in and upon the ABL Priority Collateral. The TLB does not contain any financial maintenance covenants, but is subject to a covenant package that is substantially consistent with the covenant package governing our senior notes. The TLB is subject to customary asset sale mandatory prepayment provisions and excess cash flow mandatory prepayment provisions.

notes.title: 401(k) and Profit Sharing Plan
text: 401(k) and Profit Sharing Plan We offer 401(k) plans to our U.S. and Puerto Rico employees who meet certain eligibility requirements. The U.S. 401(k) Plan allows employees to contribute immediately upon hire, while the Puerto Rico 401(k) Plan allows employees to contribute after one year of employment.
